abstract:
The paper “Taurine and cardiovascular ... of taurine on various aspects of human health, focusing on cardiovascular pathophysiology, but also including aging, athletic performance, metabolic regulation, and neurological function....
In this regard, the authors need to add to the content, such as summarizing recent research advances or research trends in the link between taurine and cardiovascular health. 2. The authors have analyzed the chemical structure of taurine, which is important. However, the authors did not go far enough in their discussion of this section, and the authors could have started with the molecular formula of taurine to explain in more detail the reasons why taurine is able to perform its beneficial effects. 3. For the introduction of taurine and vascular function, the authors need to introduce more references or relevant experimental cases to illustrate more specifically the positive significance of taurine for the maintenance of normal vascular function.
The paper “Taurine and cardiovascular health: An updated overview” provides an overview of the scientific literature and presents an analysis of the effects of taurine on various aspects of human health, focusing on cardiovascular pathophysiology, but also including aging, athletic performance, metabolic regulation, and neurological function.
While the review primarily focuses on cardiovascular health, the authors should justify why they limit it to this area despite taurine's potential benefits for various conditions like immune health, eye health, liver function, skin conditions, and mental health conditions.
It is unclear to which review this Reviewer is referring to: making a search in PubMed for reviews containing the terms "Taurine" "Aging" "Cardiovascular health" does not give any result (please see screenshot). ...
